splash_play_cta.description: Primary Reddit feed splash call-to-arms button that invokes requestExpandedMode(..., 'game') to launch the Daily Siege.

war_room_play_daily.selectorRoleOrText: role=button[name="SOUND THE HORN — PLAY DAILY SIEGE"s]
war_room_play_daily.description: Hammered brass War Room primary CTA that starts Today's deterministic 180-degree symmetric Daily Siege.

war_room_ranks_tab.description: Segmented War Room tab displaying Today's subreddit leaderboard standings, clear times, crowns, and strategies.

skirmish_forge_tab.description: Segmented War Room tab opening the Natural-Language Skirmish Forge and PE-... Reddit Challenge Code decoder.

forge_prompt_input.selectorRoleOrText: role=textbox[name="Custom Siege Prompt or Challenge Code"s]
forge_prompt_input.description: Text input accepting plain-English custom battle prompts or shareable PE-... challenge codes.

forge_craft_btn.description: Submit button that compiles the forge prompt into an A*-walkability-verified SkirmishSpec and PE-... share code.

war_room_archive_play.description: Practice Archive launch button in the War Room allowing commanders to replay deterministic past Daily Sieges.

hud_resource_ledger.description: Top resource ledger displaying live Wood, Food, Gold, Population (current/cap), 3-Crown Par clock, and match controls.

hud_scout_advisor_btn.description: Royal War-Council Scout button inside the slim top-left advisor pill that requests live counter-unit tactical counsel.

hud_taunt_btn.description: Top-right brass war-horn icon button toggling the classic Age-of-Empires taunt popover (30 Wololo!, 11, 14, 1).

hud_speed_toggle.description: Top ledger simulation speed toggle button switching active RTS pace between 1× and 1.5×.

hud_onboarding_steps.description: Tactile onboarding objective strip guiding commanders through opening economy, build, and assault steps.

squad_idle_villager.description: Quick-select squad pill highlighting and selecting idle Villagers for immediate 1-tap economy tasking.

squad_all_army.description: Quick-select squad pill selecting all living player military units across the battlefield.

squad_siege_keep.description: One-tap crimson assault pill issuing cmdAttackEnemyKeep to march all mustered military units onto the Rival Town Center.

dock_mode_train.description: Bottom command dock mode switch revealing the 6-card unit production deck (Villager, Swordsman, Pikeman, Archer, Knight, Monk).

dock_mode_build.description: Bottom command dock mode switch revealing the 6-card structure placement deck (Camp, Barracks, Range, Stable, Monastery, Tower).

minimap_canvas.description: Interactive top-right isometric diamond minimap canvas showing terrain, fog of war, empires, and camera viewport frustum.

chronicle_modal.description: End-state Siege Chronicle modal displaying 1-3 earned Crowns, clear time vs Par, battle epigraph, and Post War Chronicle to Comments CTA.
